title: Understanding Gene Expression-to-Image Learning: Spatial Structure and Information Fidelity
abstract: arXiv:2610.17699v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) enables cell-level analysis of biological heterogeneity, but learning effective representations from high-dimensional, unordered gene expression profiles remains challenging. Gene Expression-to-Image (GE2I) offers an effective learning strategy by arranging gene values on pixel grids for convolutional neural networks, but its underlying mechanisms remain unclear. We study GE2I on full-transcriptome data while keeping the network and training procedure fixed. Our results reveal a trade-off between spatial smoothness and gene-level fidelity. Structured mappings produce smooth, low-frequency patterns that support faster early optimization, whereas assigning multiple genes to the same pixel obscures expression differences and can reduce predictive performance. translated_title: 理解基因表达到图像学习：空间结构与信息保真度
translated_abstract: 单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）能够在细胞层面分析生物异质性，但从高维、无序的基因表达谱中学习有效表示仍然具有挑战性。基因表达到图像（GE2I）通过将基因值排列在像素网格上供卷积神经网络处理，提供了一种有效的学习策略，但其底层机制仍不清楚。我们在全转录组数据上研究GE2I，同时保持网络结构和训练过程固定。我们的结果揭示了空间平滑性与基因层面保真度之间的权衡。结构化映射产生平滑的低频模式，有利于更快的早期优化；而将多个基因分配到同一像素会掩盖表达差异，并可能降低预测性能。这一权衡解释了为什么当表示大量基因时，随机映射能够与结构化布局相竞争。一对一的基因到像素分配……
tldr: 本研究首次系统揭示了基因表达到图像（GE2I）学习中空间平滑性与基因保真度之间的权衡机制：结构化映射带来平滑低频模式、利于早期优化，而多基因共占同一像素会掩盖表达差异、降低预测性能。
en_tdlr: This study reveals a fundamental trade-off between spatial smoothness and gene-level fidelity in Gene Expression-to-Image (GE2I) learning: structured mappings produce smooth low-frequency patterns that accelerate early optimization, while assigning multiple genes to the same pixel obscures expression differences and can degrade predictive performance.
